prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once (e.g., adoption incentive, finish hint, finish redesign, home new_screen); firm rules require at least 2 tests.
Redesigns ('adoption, redesign', 'choose_path, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign') consistently hurt performance, frequently resulting in early stops or negative impact.
'home, wait_info' and 'finish, new_screen' are helpful kinds of changes, supported by multiple winning tests across early rounds.
No clear effect was consistently observed across multiple tests for 'adoption, layout', 'adoption, notification', 'choose_path, layout', and 'sign_in, incentive'.
Results for copy and hint changes ('choose_path, copy', 'choose_path, hint', 'adoption, hint', 'sign_in, hint') remain inconsistent, each producing occasional wins alongside non-significant results.
Predictions were regularly too high for redesigns and ineffective changes, while underpredicting the magnitude of actual winning tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Shortcut and Control Overview Screen: Insert a new screen after home_intro demonstrating primary mouse clicks, keyboard shortcuts, and tray menu toggles for controlling the desktop pet. (why: Support mail indicates users are confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet post-onboarding.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Engine Initialization Status: Display dynamic renderer loading updates on the waiting screen during pet creation to explain processing times and avoid abandonment. (why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s, and home step waiting screen takes 201s. Providing wait_info on home/waiting has proven successful in earlier rounds.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Pet Hide and Show Practice Flow: Add a guided practice flow at the finish step where users practice hiding and summoning their pet from the system tray. (why: Support emails highlight confusion on how to hide or summon pets after setup, and finish step drop-off is 12.4%.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Generation Time Expectation Hint: Display a clear hint on the upload_photos screen explaining processing time expectations and quality requirements. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel leak (62.3% conversion, median 89s / mean 1017s) and 3 support emails reported custom pet failures.)
4: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Voice and Chat Tutorial Screen: Add a dedicated setup screen after home_intro explaining how to talk to and command the pet via text or voice. (why: Support feedback shows confusion regarding how to talk to or command pets once onboarding finishes.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Existing Pet Data Synchronization Alert: Show a notification badge on sign_in explaining that signing into an existing account will sync saved pets across devices. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] System Tray Pet Access Hint during Waiting: Update waiting screen hint to clarify where the app icon sits in the system tray while components download. (why: 3 support emails report pet not showing on desktop or app not opening, while home waiting screen has high mean wait time (2336s).)
7: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Welcome Hub Redesign: Redesign home_intro into a structured welcome hub with full desktop placement overview, interaction cards, and clear launch button. (why: Finish step has high mean duration (5815s) and 93.2% home to 87.6% finish conversion.)
8: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Guarantee Headline Copy: Update the headline and body of adoption_certificate to reassure users about pet saves and auto-backup before entering the desktop. (why: Adoption step is the lowest performing funnel step (62.3% conversion) and users worry about pet loss on sign in.)
